anyOf.$comment: forbidden Morph top-level metadata; canonical path is metadata.title or encrypted_metadata
forbidden Morph top-level metadata; canonical path is metadata.summary or encrypted_metadata
forbidden encrypted content carrier; canonical name is encrypted_content

scope_circle_id.description: Optional reference to an intra-Realm Circle that defines this Morph's effective scope. Omitted means Realm-default scope. Reducer enforces scope_circle_id.realm_id == Morph.realm_id and stamps immutable effective_scope onto emitted events.

schema_refs.description: Authoritative schema set for Morph fields and transition validation. Reducers MUST validate fields against exactly these refs; morph_type and facets are not a replacement for schema_refs.

encrypted_metadata.description: Encrypted envelope whose plaintext is a morph_metadata object. Required instead of plaintext metadata when the effective metadata_encryption_floor is e2ee_required.

encrypted_content.description: Encrypted envelope whose plaintext is a ContentBlock for Morph content.

state.description: Morph lifecycle state. 'active' is the default. Reducer enforces transitions per common-fields.md §5.1: ck.morph.archive MUST come from 'active' (else failed_precondition reason=morph_not_active); ck.morph.restore MUST come from 'archived' (else morph_not_archived); ck.redaction targeting the morph MUST come from {'active','archived'} (else morph_already_terminal). Same-state self-transitions MUST fail. 'redacted' is the irreversible terminal.

state_changed_at.description: Reducer-derived timestamp of the most recent state transition. MUST be set when state != 'active'; MUST be the created_at of the corresponding ck.morph.archive / ck.morph.restore / redaction Event. Aligns with Space.state_changed_at and the common-fields rule in models/common-fields.md §3.

stage.description: Morph business-progression stage. Orthogonal to top-level 'state' (physical lifecycle). Required on ck.morph.create (no protocol-level default). The only wire path that mutates stage is the dedicated ck.morph.stage.set event; ck.morph.update / ck.morph.schema_migrate patches on stage / stage_changed_at MUST be rejected (schema_violation, single-source). Stage transitions intentionally do NOT carry a reason / note field — the ck.morph.stage.set event log is the audit source; human-readable explanations belong in a Message on an associated discussion track that references the event. See models/common-fields.md §5.3 for full semantics.

stage_changed_at.description: Reducer-derived timestamp of the most recent stage transition. MUST be ignored when present on wire; reducer overwrites with the triggering ck.morph.stage.set event's created_at. Same-value self-transitions MUST NOT update this field.

morph_metadata.description: Extensible user-readable Morph metadata. Morph business fields stay in the top-level fields object; metadata carries display-oriented fields such as title and summary. In MLS / E2EE realms this object is encrypted as encrypted_metadata unless the Realm explicitly opts into plaintext metadata.

not.$comment: Reducer-owned fields and Morph business fields stay top-level and MUST NOT be mirrored inside metadata.

Reject discriminator field `type`, composite child array name `blocks`, and byte-count field `size`; canonical content blocks use `kind`, composite children use `parts`, and byte counts use `size_bytes`.
